### Summary

This section keeps the selector and the guard of the radial velocity correction; the covariance identity and
the finite-difference form are derived in @sec-ch04-x1masscov and are not repeated here.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Selects the radial mean conversion of @eq-ch04-x1masscov-gap.

**Data.** Density and radial velocity in; corrected reconstruction velocity out.

**Placement.** Well-balanced radial branch, before reconstruction; input restored afterwards.

**Activation.** `SNAP_X1_MASS_COVARIANCE=1`, default off.

**Guarantee / limits.** With radial gravity, at least three owned radial cells are required.

**Evidence.** Tests below, @tbl-ch12-mass-covariance-tests; solver ctests were not run.
:::

Local symbols: $\rho$ is density [$\mathrm{kg\,m^{-3}}$], radial velocity has units [m s$^{-1}$], and $\Delta x_1$
is cell width [m].

### Derivation

See @sec-ch04-x1masscov for the mean-conversion identity. The chapter's check line `[C4]` re-derives the
mass-weighted mean with rational polynomial integration, together with the lateral covariance identity it shares
the derivation with [check `src/snapy_report/ch12/checks/configuration_check.py`, output
`src/snapy_report/ch12/checks/configuration_check.out`].

### Numerical method

`HydroImpl::x1_mass_covariance` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::x1_mass_covariance >}}) reads the
variable once, off unless set to a value outside the false tokens. With nonzero $g_1$ the setup of the hydro
module refuses fewer than three owned $x_1$ cells (`HydroImpl::reset`, {{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::reset >}}),
because the one-sided wall slope spans three cells. In the well-balanced branch of `HydroImpl::forward`
({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}) the correction forms centred density and velocity
differences, replaces the density slope in the first and last cell by a one-sided second-order slope at a
physical non-outflow wall, subtracts the covariance term from the radial velocity, gives the corrected velocity
odd ghosts at those walls, reconstructs it with the density and pressure perturbations, and restores the input
velocity afterwards. The correction is part of each explicit hydro call; it adds no implicit matrix term.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch12-mass-covariance-flow
#| fig-cap: "Radial velocity mean correction: labelled boxes show inputs and decisions in evaluation order. This is a configuration or stencil diagram, not measured data."
#| fig-alt: "rho-weighted velocity; centered slopes; wall: three owned cells; subtract covariance; reconstruct and restore."
#| echo: false
from snapy_report.ch12.figures.fig_mass_covariance_flow import make_fig
```

### Code

**How to use it.** Set `SNAP_X1_MASS_COVARIANCE=1` before launch and give each block at least three owned
radial cells. This gravity fragment belongs inside a complete input card:

```yaml
forcing:
  const-gravity:
    grav1: -9.8     # m s^-2
    gravity-work: cell
```

For two owned cells with radial gravity, reset refuses the stencil with
"SNAP_X1_MASS_COVARIANCE needs at least 3 x1 cells per block, got 2; unset it".
Ghost cells do not count towards this minimum: the one-sided wall slope uses owned cells.

`HydroImpl::forward` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}) contains this selection step:

```cpp
        wx1[IVX] -= dx1f * dx1f / 12. * rho_1 * w_1 / density;
```

Here `dx1f` is the radial cell width [m], `rho_1` the density slope [$\mathrm{kg\,m^{-4}}$],
and `w_1` the radial velocity slope [$\mathrm{s^{-1}}$]. Dividing their product by density gives the velocity
correction [m s$^{-1}$] in @eq-ch04-x1masscov-gap, whose linear identity is checked by `[C4]`.

| guard | {{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::reset >}} | `nx1`[^rg-ac0af326b0a9] | `SNAP_X1_MASS_COVARIANCE` |
| correction | {{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}} | `rho_1` | `SNAP_X1_MASS_COVARIANCE` |
| guard test | {{< code tests/test_x1_seam_split.cpp X1SeamSplit.x1_mass_covariance_needs_3_x1_cells >}} | `x1_mass_covariance_needs_3_x1_cells` | `SNAP_X1_MASS_COVARIANCE` |

: Implementation sites for the mass-covariance selector. {#tbl-ch12-mass-covariance-code}

1. Read the switch once. The anchor `x1_mass_covariance` is in
   {{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::x1_mass_covariance >}}.
2. At setup with gravity, refuse fewer than three owned $x_1$ cells. The anchor `nx1` is in
   {{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::reset >}}.
3. In the well-balanced branch, correct the velocity, reconstruct, restore. The anchor `rho_1` is in
   {{< code src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp HydroImpl::forward >}}.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
Interior, wall, seam, CUDA, MPI and combined-switch accuracy of this correction are unmeasured; the only
registered evidence is the setup guard. The Cartesian coefficient does not establish exactness on a curved
measure.

The complete switch inventory is @sec-ch12-matrix.
:::
